messages:
laura: Heads-up: large regulated customer wants an air-gapped POC next month. They require sideload-only install (no persistent outbound). Can we provide a signed offline bundle + a small weekly delta patch? Also they want a 90-day trial license that installs offline. cc @mike

mike: We can support that. Need two confirmations: max bundle size they can accept (they mentioned ~15GB) and allowed signature formats (GPG vs x509). What metadata do they need in the bundle manifest?

laura: Ops said <20GB preferred, security requested CycloneDX SBOM, checksum, signing cert chain, and upgrade instructions.

indra: Security: CycloneDX is fine but we need signed SBOMs and provenance info. Also require KMS/HSM integration notes for on-prem key storage and explanation for how secrets are injected in air-gapped installs. No shortcuts on these items, but we can prioritize review.

samir: Packaging: we offer full bundles (.tar.gz) and minibundles (binary diffs) produced by our release pipeline. Minibundles are signed and require the prior full bundle. Tooling: we use internal rdu-delta but can produce bsdiff-compatible deltas if they prefer.

mike: Are minibundles safe for weekly cadence? Customer wants weekly patches during the 4-week POC, and ability to roll back if patch fails.

samir: Weekly deltas doable if no schema/major changes. Minibundles supported only within same major version. Rollback path: keep previous full bundle on jumpbox and run included rollback.sh. We'll add a manifest field compatible_rollbacks with allowed versions.

indra: We also need an integrity verification guide for the customer's ops: commands like `sha256sum bundle.tar.gz` and `gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz` and an SBOM signature verification example. We'll supply scripts.

laura: About the offline license: they want a time-limited license blob that works without contacting our service. Can we sign a license tied to host fingerprint?

mike: Yes. We'll issue an offline license token signed by our license KMS containing customer_id, allowed_nodes, fingerprint, and expires_at. The installer validates it locally. Legal needs to approve the offline trial terms.

indra: Security requires license revocation capability. For air-gapped sites with monthly sync windows, revocation can be handled via a signed CRL minibundle included in scheduled deltas. We'll document revocation semantics and timelines.

laura: For network: they insist no outbound. If we do offer a mirror/proxy mode, what minimal ports/IPs are needed?

samir: Installer supports three modes: fully offline (no outbound; uses sideloaded artifacts), mirror mode (jumpbox accesses customer-hosted mirror), or narrow-window proxy to our mirror. Fully offline needs no ports. Mirror/proxy needs egress to HTTPS (443) to specified IPs; we'll provide IP ranges and cert fingerprints.

mike: Ops asked for a sample artifact to validate sideloading flow. Can we ship a tiny proof-of-concept bundle this week?

samir: I'll generate a sample bundle (small runtime stub + SBOM + sig + rollback script) and push to artifact-bot. ETA: EOD Thu.

artifact-bot: Uploaded `airgap-sample-0.1.tar.gz` size 9.8MB sha256: `5b1c2d3e4f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2` signature at `/artifacts/airgap-sample-0.1.tar.gz.sig`

mike: I'll share the artifact + minimal install steps and ask their ops to run unpack & verification in their sandbox. Also will flag an expedited security/legal review for the offline trial terms.

indra: I'll draft answers for the security questionnaire items: SBOM handling, signing, build provenance, KMS notes, revocation, audit logs. Will post doc here when ready.

laura: Thanks team. If ops validates the flow this week, sales will request accelerated legal review for a 1-week turnaround.

mike: Next steps: 1) send artifact and instructions, 2) ops test, 3) security Q&A draft, 4) legal offline license approval. I'll follow up after test.

laura: Closing loop 1; thanks :thumbsup:
